item.title: Michael Jackson Film Moves Up Our List of Highest-Grossing Music Biopics Worldwide: See Where It Ranks
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our show, where we dive into the latest news and trends in the entertainment industry. Today, we're talking about the brand-new Michael Jackson film, "Michael", which has already made a significant impact at the box office.
[Short music transition]
Host: According to recent reports, "Michael" has grossed an impressive $424.8 million worldwide in its first 10 days of release. This milestone puts it at number 2 on Billboard's list of music biopics with the highest worldwide grosses. The film is already outperforming other notable music biopics, including "Michael Jackson's This Is It", which grossed $268 million worldwide back in 2009.
[Short music transition]
Host: What's interesting is that international ticket sales account for nearly two-thirds of the film's box office total, with 66.1% coming from outside the US and Canada. The film's success is no surprise, given Michael Jackson's long history of topping charts and breaking records, dating back to his days with The Jackson 5.
[Short music transition]
Host: However, it's worth noting that the all-time top-grossing music biopic, "Bohemian Rhapsody", still holds the top spot with a whopping $910.8 million worldwide gross. The producer of "Michael", Graham King, also worked on "Bohemian Rhapsody" and another successful music biopic, "Jersey Boys".
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's update on the Michael Jackson film "Michael". We'll be keeping an eye on its progress and seeing if it can continue to break records. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode!
